name: MonarchAiClaimSources
title: AiClaimSources
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column of claims, each a disclosure (androidx.compose.foundation.clickable with Role.Button and androidx.compose.animation.AnimatedVisibility) with MonarchBadge; androidx.compose.material3.SingleChoiceSegmentedButtonRow for the filter; MonarchButton, MonarchCopyButton and android.icu.text.DateFormat for the passages
summary: Where an assistant's answer came from: its claims, how well the sources back each one in plain words, and, for an open claim, the exact passages with their source, location, date and stance.
whenToUse: Under an assistant's answer, or in a sheet opened from it, when people need to check each statement against the passages that back or contradict it.
whenNotToUse: For a plain list of the sources an answer used, use MonarchAiSourceList. For one inline source marker, use MonarchAiCitation.
api: @ExperimentalMonarchApi @Composable fun MonarchAiClaimSources(claims: List<MonarchAiClaim>, sources: List<MonarchAiClaimSource>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, expandedIds: Set<String>? = null, onExpandedChange: ((Set<String>) -> Unit)? = null, filter: MonarchAiClaimSourcesFilter? = null, onFilterChange: ((MonarchAiClaimSourcesFilter) -> Unit)? = null, selectedClaimId: String? = null, onSelectClaim: ((String) -> Unit)? = null, onOpenSource: ((MonarchAiClaimSource, MonarchAiClaimEvidence) -> Unit)? = null, onFlag: ((String) -> Unit)? = null, onVerify: ((String) -> Unit)? = null, onCopyQuote: ((MonarchAiClaimEvidence) -> Unit)? = null, supportIcon: (@Composable (MonarchAiClaimSupport) -> Unit)? = null, expandIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchAiClaimSourcesLabels = MonarchAiClaimSourcesLabels())
data class MonarchAiClaim(id: String, text: String, support: MonarchAiClaimSupport, evidence: List<MonarchAiClaimEvidence> = emptyList()) { val needsChecking: Boolean }
data class MonarchAiClaimEvidence(id: String, sourceId: String, quote: String, location: String? = null, stance: MonarchAiClaimEvidenceStance? = null)

data class MonarchAiClaimSource(id: String, title: String, url: String? = null, kind: MonarchAiSourceKind? = null, publishedMillis: Long? = null) { constructor(part: MonarchAiSourcePart, publishedMillis: Long? = null) }
enum class MonarchAiClaimSupport { Supported, Partial, Unsupported, Conflicting, Unchecked }

data class MonarchAiClaimCounts(total: Int, needsChecking: Int, supported: Int, partial: Int, unsupported: Int, conflicting: Int, unchecked: Int) { companion object { fun of(claims: List<MonarchAiClaim>): MonarchAiClaimCounts } }

class MonarchAiClaimSourcesLabels(heading: String? = null, summary: ((MonarchAiClaimCounts) -> String)? = null, filterLabel: String? = null, all: String? = null, needsChecking: String? = null, support: ((MonarchAiClaimSupport) -> String)? = null, note: ((MonarchAiClaimSupport) -> String)? = null, passages: ((count: Int) -> String)? = null, evidenceLabel: ((claim: String) -> String)? = null, stance: ((MonarchAiClaimEvidenceStance) -> String)? = null, unknownSource: String? = null, published: ((date: String) -> String)? = null, kind: ((MonarchAiSourceKind) -> String)? = null, openSource: String? = null, fromSource: ((title: String) -> String)? = null, copyQuote: String? = null, copied: String? = null, copiedAnnouncement: String? = null, flag: String? = null, verify: String? = null, empty: String? = null, noneNeedChecking: String? = null, noEvidence: String? = null, showing: ((shown: Int, total: Int) -> String)? = null, expanded: String? = null, collapsed: String? = null)

options.name: claims
options.description: The claims of the answer, in the order the answer makes them.

options.name: sources
options.description: The sources the passages point at. MonarchAiClaimSource(part) builds one from a MonarchAiSourcePart of the message.

options.name: expandedIds
options.description: The ids of the open claims, when the app keeps them. Kept in the view, all closed at first, when null.

options.name: onExpandedChange
options.description: Called with the new set of open claim ids when a claim opens or closes.

options.name: filter
options.description: The filter, when the app keeps it. Kept in the view, starting with All, when null.

options.name: onFilterChange
options.description: Called when the person changes the filter.

options.name: selectedClaimId
options.description: The selected claim, such as the sentence the person tapped in the answer. When null the view selects the last claim the person opened or closed.

options.name: onSelectClaim
options.description: Called with a claim's id when the person opens or closes it, so the app can highlight that sentence in the answer.

options.name: onOpenSource
options.description: Opens a passage's source in the app, for example in MonarchAiSourcePreview. Without it, Open source shows only for an http, https or mailto address and opens it outside the app.

options.name: onFlag
options.description: Shows Report a problem in every open claim; called with the claim's id.

options.name: onVerify
options.description: Shows Check again in open, unchecked claims; called with the claim's id.

options.name: onCopyQuote
options.description: Called with the passage after Copy quote.

options.name: supportIcon
options.description: An icon for a support level, shown in its badge and hidden from TalkBack. Monarch bundles no icons.

options.name: expandIcon
options.description: An icon at the start of each claim's header, such as a chevron that points down; it points down while the claim is open and to the end while it is closed.

states.name: closed claims
states.description: Each claim shows its text, its support level as a toned badge in words and the number of passages.

states.name: open claim
states.description: A note for a claim that is not fully supported, the passages as quotations with the source title, kind, location, publication date and stance, and Open source and Copy quote for each.

states.name: selected
states.description: The selected claim's header has the accent subtle fill and an accent bar at its start, and is marked selected for TalkBack.

states.name: needs checking
states.description: The filter shows only the claims that are not fully supported; "Showing 1 of 5 claims" is announced.

states.name: nothing needs checking
states.description: Needs checking with every claim supported says so in words.

states.name: no claims
states.description: The summary reads "No claims", the filter is hidden and a line says there are no claims to check.

appearance: The heading in the subheading style with a muted summary, Material 3 segmented buttons for the filter, claim headers in the strong body style with success, warning, danger or neutral badges, and passages as quotations on the subtle fill with a bar in the success or danger border color by stance. Stance words use the success or danger strong color. All are theme roles, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: The parity map names a LazyColumn of claims; the claims are a plain Column, because the view sits under an answer inside the app's scrolling conversation or in a sheet, where a LazyColumn without a fixed height cannot be measured. Each claim is a disclosure with MonarchCollapsible's semantics (button, Expanded or Collapsed, expand and collapse actions), drawn by the component because MonarchCollapsible's header takes only a text label and the support badge must stay visible while the claim is closed. The web filter is its SegmentedControl with counts; Android uses the Material 3 segmented buttons with the count in the label. The web opens a safe link in a new tab and lets onOpenSource prevent it; Android opens the address outside the app only when there is no onOpenSource. The web's arrow, Home and End keys between claims are TalkBack's own navigation here. The web's controlled and uncontrolled pairs (expandedIds, filter, selectedClaimId) are nullable values that the view keeps when null. publishedAt is publishedMillis in epoch milliseconds, formatted in the device locale in UTC; the web's locale prop is the device locale. Monarch bundles no icons, so the support and expand icons are slots. iOS has no AiClaimSources yet. The composable is experimental: an AI panel that waits for a Rook app to adopt it.
accessibility: The heading has the heading semantics; the claims are a traversal group named by the heading, and each claim's passages a group named "Passages for: <claim>".

Each claim header is one button that reads the claim, its support level and its number of passages, with the state Expanded or Collapsed, the expand and collapse actions and a touch target of at least 48dp.
The selected claim is marked selected, not only coloured.
Support levels and stances are words; the badge colors and quote bars only repeat them.
Open source and Copy quote are named with the source, such as "Open source from Q3 report", so the actions of each passage are told apart.
A filter change is announced through a polite live region; the first filter is not announced.
Text wraps at the largest font size; the support and expand icons are hidden from TalkBack.
edgeCases: A passage whose source is not in sources shows "Unknown source" and no Open source button.
A source address that is not http, https or mailto (javascript:, file:, relative) is never opened.
An open claim without passages shows its note, or "No passages were provided for this claim." when it is supported.
Check again shows only on unchecked claims.
A claim id missing from claims but present in expandedIds is ignored.

CompositionLocalProvider(LocalConfiguration provides locale) {
    @OptIn(ExperimentalMonarchApi::class)
    MonarchAiClaimSources(
        claims = listOf(
        MonarchAiClaim(
            id = "c1",
            text = "Requests are answered within two working days.",
            support = MonarchAiClaimSupport.Supported,
            evidence = listOf(
                MonarchAiClaimEvidence(id = "e1", sourceId = "s1", quote = "We answer every request within two working days.", location = "Page 4", stance = MonarchAiClaimEvidenceStance.Supports),
            ),
        ),
        MonarchAiClaim(
            id = "c2",
            text = "Urgent issues are handled within one hour.",
            support = MonarchAiClaimSupport.Conflicting,
            evidence = listOf(
                MonarchAiClaimEvidence(id = "e2", sourceId = "s2", quote = "Urgent issues go to the on-call queue and are picked up within one hour.", location = "Section 2.1", stance = MonarchAiClaimEvidenceStance.Supports),
                MonarchAiClaimEvidence(id = "e3", sourceId = "s3", quote = "Marked urgent at 09:10. First reply at 15:42.", location = "Activity log", stance = MonarchAiClaimEvidenceStance.Contradicts),
            ),
        ),
        MonarchAiClaim(
            id = "c3",
            text = "Refunds are paid within five days to the original payment method.",
            support = MonarchAiClaimSupport.Partial,
            evidence = listOf(
                MonarchAiClaimEvidence(id = "e4", sourceId = "s2", quote = "Refunds go back to the original payment method.", location = "Section 5", stance = MonarchAiClaimEvidenceStance.Supports),
            ),
        ),
        MonarchAiClaim(
            id = "c4",
            text = "Support is open at weekends.",
            support = MonarchAiClaimSupport.Unsupported,
        ),
        MonarchAiClaim(
            id = "c5",
            text = "The office moved in May.",
            support = MonarchAiClaimSupport.Unchecked,
        ),
        ),
        sources = listOf(
        MonarchAiClaimSource(id = "s1", title = "Team handbook", url = "https://example.com/handbook", kind = MonarchAiSourceKind.Doc, publishedMillis = 1_772_496_000_000L),
        MonarchAiClaimSource(id = "s2", title = "Support policy", url = "https://example.com/support-policy", kind = MonarchAiSourceKind.Web, publishedMillis = 1_763_596_800_000L),
        MonarchAiClaimSource(id = "s3", title = "Ticket 1042", kind = MonarchAiSourceKind.Record),
        ),
        expandedIds = expanded,
        onExpandedChange = { expanded = it },
        supportIcon = { support ->
            when (support) {
                MonarchAiClaimSupport.Supported -> MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Success, contentDescription = null)
                MonarchAiClaimSupport.Partial -> MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Partial, contentDescription = null)
                MonarchAiClaimSupport.Unsupported -> MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Error, contentDescription = null)
                MonarchAiClaimSupport.Conflicting -> MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Warning, contentDescription = null)
                MonarchAiClaimSupport.Unchecked -> MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Help, contentDescription = null)
            }
        },
        expandIcon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.ChevronDown, contentDescription = null) },
    )
